description: This Java class implements the LoanAmortizationAllocationService interface, providing methods to retrieve loan amortization allocations related to specific loan transactions (Buy Down Fee and Capitalized Income), calculate amortized amounts, and manage amortization allocation mappings for a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanAmortizationAllocationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of LoanAmortizationAllocationService that manages loan amortization allocations, including retrieval, calculation, and mapping operations, leveraging various repositories and domain objects.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationAllocationsForBuyDownFeeTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves amortization allocations associated with a buy-down fee transaction, validating transaction type and delegating data retrieval.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationAllocationsForCapitalizedIncomeTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves amortization allocations associated with a capitalized income transaction, validating transaction type and delegating data retrieval.

methods.name: calculateAlreadyAmortizedAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount already amortized for a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationAllocationData
methods.description: Internal method that assembles comprehensive amortization allocation data for a loan transaction, including mappings.

methods.name: getBaseTransactionInfo
methods.description: Fetches base transaction info based on transaction type (buy-down fee or capitalized income).

methods.name: createAmortizationAllocationMappingWithBaseLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new positional loan amortization allocation mapping with the base loan transaction details.

methods.name: setAmortizationTransactionDataAndSaveAmortizationAllocationMapping
methods.description: Updates and persists a loan amortization allocation mapping with data from an amortization transaction.
